title: A Single Mutation Enhancing the DNA-Binding Affinity of Cra Redirects Metabolism for High-Yield Succinate Production in Escherichia coli.
authors: Wei, Wan-Fang; Wang, Ruo-Lin; Huang, Ying; Tang, Meng-Ying; Jia, Kai-Zhi; Wang, Wei-Ping; Zhao, Wei; Liu, Xiao-Nan; Zhu, Li-Wen
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过Cra转录因子R60A突变增强DNA结合亲和力并重定向代谢，结合分子对接预测突变体-DNA复合物结合模式，属于TF-DNA互作机制与代谢工程结合的研究，方法上仅用分子对接，深度有限但对象和互作核心匹配。
abstract: Rational engineering of transcription factors is an attractive strategy to modulate microbial metabolism. This study demonstrated its effectiveness through a key mutation (R60A) in the understudied linker region of the global transcription factor Cra. Transcriptional and enzymatic analyses revealed that R60A upregulated multiple genes and enhanced several key enzyme activities in central carbon metabolism, including the direct Cra targets pck and aceB, which were selected for further mechanistic investigation. In vitro binding assays confirmed that R60A bound to the promoter regions of these genes with enhanced affinity. Molecular docking analysis predicted that the top-ranked binding poses of the WT and R60A complexes differ in DNA placement, with an altered set of predicted hydrogen-bond contacts. This mutation altered the central carbon metabolism, leading to improved CO2 fixation and succinate biosynthesis. Coupled with an optimized exponential feeding strategy that precisely controlled the specific growth rate, this approach achieved a high succinate titer of 100.8 g/L. Our work suggests a possible role for linker-mediated geometric modulation of DNA binding by Cra and presents an integrated metabolic and process engineering strategy for efficient succinate production.
abstract_zh: 转录因子的理性工程改造是调节微生物代谢的一种有吸引力的策略。本研究通过全球转录因子Cra中未被充分研究的连接区的一个关键突变（R60A）证明了其有效性。转录和酶学分析显示，R60A上调了多个基因，并增强了中心碳代谢中几种关键酶的活性，包括直接靶标pck和aceB，这些被选作进一步机制研究。体外结合实验确认，R60A以增强的亲和力结合这些基因的启动子区域。分子对接分析预测，WT和R60A复合物的最高排名结合姿态在DNA位置上有所不同，且预测的氢键接触集合发生改变。该突变改变了中心碳代谢，导致CO2固定和琥珀酸生物合成改善。结合精确控制比生长速率的优化指数补料策略，该方法实现了100.8 g/L的高琥珀酸滴度。我们的工作提示了Cra通过连接区介导的几何调节在DNA结合中的可能作用，并提出了一种集成的代谢和过程工程策略，用于高效生产琥珀酸。
